# Josie Pye

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006)</sub>
- **Origin:** Avonlea  <sub>[v1 c34 P11](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0011), [v1 c38 P40](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0040)</sub>
- **Role:** student  <sub>[v1 c30 P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021), [v1 c34 P11](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0011)</sub>

## Appearance

Josie is stout and fat. She was considered too fat to play the part of a fairy queen in a school dialogue.

_Sources: [v1 c24 P14](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0014)_

## Personality

Josie is sharp-tongued, malicious, disagreeable, and lacking in imagination. She is known for being a cheat, sulky when she does not get her way, and triumphantly taunting toward others. She acts scornfully envious of others' achievements, often making unkind comments and casting doubt on their accomplishments.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P26](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0026), [v1 c15 P47](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0047), [v1 c23 P6](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0006), [v1 c23 P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041), [v1 c24 P14](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0014), [v1 c33 P34](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0034), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006), [v1 c37 P33](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0033), [v3 c11 P41](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0041), [v3 c16 P2](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0002)_

## History

Josie attended Avonlea school, where she was the last of the long-standing Pye family to be enrolled. During her school days, she possessed a natural skill for walking board fences and once successfully walked a garden fence on a dare, which led Anne Shirley to attempt walking a ridgepole. She participated in an exhibition where she won first prize for her knitted lace. At one point, she fell out with Julia Bell, leading to a three-month period where they did not speak after Josie made a mocking comment about Julia's bow during recitations. After preparing for the Entrance examinations, Josie attended Queen's Academy to pursue Second Class coursework, earning a reputation as the sharpest-tongued student there. She later stated her intention to go to college purely for education's sake, as she did not need to earn her own living.

_Sources: [v1 c23 P6](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0006), [v1 c23 P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041), [v1 c26 P2](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0002), [v1 c29 P24](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0024), [v1 c30 P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021), [v1 c34 P11](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0011), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006), [v1 c38 P40](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0040)_
